body:
🕷️ **_The Multiverse Protocol_**
Unleash God-Tier Abilities in Vanilla Minecraft

What if your gear didn’t just protect you…
but turned you into a walking multiverse anomaly?

The Multiverse Protocol is a high-powered abilities plugin that transforms weapons and armor into ability-driven artifacts, each with unique mechanics, movement tech, and combat powers.

🛠️ Features
⚔️ The Arsenal — Custom Weapons

Each weapon is hard-coded with metadata verification, meaning only the real items can trigger abilities (no fakes 👀).

🕸️ Weaver’s Paradox (Netherite Sword)

Sharpness VII, Unbreaking X

/ability:lunge → Launch forward with insane speed + glide boost

🏹 Web-Slinger (Bow)

Power X, Infinity I

/ability:pull → Pull ALL entities within 15 blocks toward you

🔊 Sonic Pulser (Mace)

Density V, Wind Burst III

/ability:sonic → Warden-style sonic blast
💥 Deals 30 damage + massive knockback

⚡ Storm-Chaser (Trident)

Riptide III, Channeling, Unbreaking X

Landing after launch/fall triggers Lightning Circle Smash
🌩️ 3 expanding rings of lightning around impact
🛡️ Stealth Suit — Passive Armor Abilities

No commands needed. Just wear and dominate.

🧠 Silence Helm (Silence Trim)

Venom Strike → 1.3x–1.5x melee damage
Applies Slowness III

🌊 Tide Plate (Tide Trim)

Thor’s Touch → Right-click to summon lightning (50 block range)

🦴 Rib Leggings (Rib Trim)

Invisibility Cloak → Sneak = 10s invisibility

👢 Sentry Boots (Sentry Trim)

Gravity Suspension → No fall damage
Gravity Leap → Sneak to launch into the air
📜 Commands

/godkit

Instantly receive ALL custom weapons + armor
Fully enchanted, trimmed, and ready to break reality
⚙️ Technical Highlights

✅ Built for Paper / Spigot 1.20+ (works on 1.21.x)

🎨 Uses Kyori Adventure API for clean text formatting

🔍 Bulletproof item detection (works even if lore/colors change)

🛡️ Crash-safe checks (instance of ArmorMeta)

⏱️ Smart cooldown system (prevents ability spam)

⚡ Why This Plugin?
Turns Minecraft into a movement + combat sandbox
Perfect for SMPs, PvP servers, and content creators
Feels like Spider-Verse + Thor + Warden powers combined

📦 Installation:
Drop the .jar into your /plugins folder
Restart server
Run /godkit
Break the game responsibly 😈

🚀 Future Plans:
More weapons & armor sets
Ability upgrades
Configurable cooldowns & damage
Boss mobs 👀[maybe]
